meta.title: Deleting a section asks for confirmation

steps.note: Open the multi-stage event creation screen.
Configure the event with an RFP stage.
Move to the RFP stage before selecting its template.
Apply an available RFP template containing sections.

args.goal: On the RFP template section editor, click the Delete icon for a section; verify that a confirmation pop-up appears before deletion; confirm the deletion; stop when the deleted section is no longer listed

steps.note: Execute and observe the section-level delete confirmation and removal flow.
Assert the resulting screen has no error, crash, or invalid rendering after deletion.
